context_for_next_testing_agent: IT Admin Auto-Provisioning fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/acms/templates for CRUD, POST /api/acms/provision/onboard for auto-provisioning, POST /api/acms/provision/offboard for auto-revocation. All audit logging verified in /api/acms/audit-logs. Frontend Templates tab at /it-admin/tools-access shows templates table and Create Template dialog with tool selection checkboxes. Auto-provisioning hooks also integrated in HR routes (create_employee, update_employee, terminate_employee) and access_control routes (activate_employee, deactivate_employee).

Backend: GET /api/acms/templates.details: Lists all templates with department_name, tool_names enrichment

Backend: POST /api/acms/templates.details: Creates template with name, description, department_id, tool_ids, default_access_level, is_active

Backend: PUT /api/acms/templates/{id}.details: Updates template fields, changes persisted and verified

Backend: DELETE /api/acms/templates/{id}.details: Hard deletes template from acms_tool_templates collection

Backend: POST /api/acms/provision/onboar.details: Auto-provisions tools based on matching templates (department/role), returns templates_matched and tools_provisioned count

Backend: POST /api/acms/provision/offboa.details: Revokes all active tool access for user, returns tools_revoked count

Backend: GET /api/acms/provision/history.details: Returns provisioning history from audit logs

Backend: Audit Logging.details: All provisioning actions logged: access_auto_provisioned, access_auto_revoked, onboarding_provisioning_completed, offboarding_revocation_completed, template_created, template_deleted

Frontend: Create Template Dialog.details: Dialog opens with Template Name, Description, Scope Settings (Department dropdown, Default Access Level), Select Tools to Provision (checkbox list with tool names and costs), Active toggle
